senses.title: The study of spectra
senses.definition: the branch of physics and chemistry that studies how matter interacts with radiation at different wavelengths
senses.definitionCN: 物理学与化学中研究物质如何与各波长辐射相互作用的分支
senses.example: Astronomers used spectroscopy to read the chemistry of a distant star from its lines.
senses.exampleCN: 天文学家借光谱分析从谱线读出遥远恒星的化学组成。
senses.why: the name is spectrum plus the Greek suffix -skopia, meaning the act of viewing, so it names a whole discipline of looking at spectra.
senses.whyCN: 名称是 spectrum 加希腊后缀 -skopia「观看之事」，因此它命名的是一门观看光谱的完整学科。

senses.title: Reading starlight
senses.titleCN: 天文光谱学：由星光谱线推断天体
senses.definition: the use of spectra to determine the composition, temperature and motion of celestial bodies
senses.definitionCN: 用光谱测定天体的成分、温度与运动
senses.example: Stellar spectroscopy showed that the sun contains iron and calcium.
senses.exampleCN: 恒星光谱分析表明太阳含有铁与钙。
senses.why: astronomy cannot visit its objects, so the spectrum becomes the only message received from them.
senses.whyCN: 天文学无法亲临研究对象，光谱就成了唯一收到的讯息。

senses.title: Absorption spectroscopy
senses.titleCN: 吸收光谱法：看物质吃掉了哪些波长
senses.definition: the technique of passing a continuous spectrum through a sample and reading the wavelengths it absorbs
senses.definitionCN: 让连续谱穿过样品，读取被其吸收的波长
senses.example: Absorption spectroscopy identified the dye from the bands it removed.
senses.exampleCN: 吸收光谱法从被它吸收掉的条带认出了这种染料。
senses.why: a substance absorbs only the wavelengths its electrons or bonds can take, so the gaps become a signature.
senses.whyCN: 物质只吸收其电子或化学键能接受的波长，于是那些缺口就成了签名。

senses.title: Emission spectroscopy
senses.titleCN: 发射光谱法：看受激物质放出哪些波长
senses.definition: the technique of heating or exciting a sample and recording the wavelengths it emits
senses.definitionCN: 加热或激发样品，记录它所放出的波长
senses.example: Emission spectroscopy revealed caesium where no one had expected it.
senses.exampleCN: 发射光谱法在无人预料之处发现了铯。
senses.why: an excited atom returns to a lower state by sending out fixed quanta, and those quanta are the emitted lines.
senses.whyCN: 受激原子回到较低状态时放出固定的一份份能量，这些能量就是发射谱线。

senses.title: Raman spectroscopy
senses.titleCN: 拉曼光谱法：测散射光的微小频移
senses.definition: a technique that reads the small shifts in wavelength when laser light is scattered by molecular vibrations
senses.definitionCN: 读取激光被分子振动散射后波长微小偏移的方法
senses.example: Raman spectroscopy distinguished two powders that looked identical.
senses.exampleCN: 拉曼光谱法把两种看起来相同的粉末区分开来。
senses.why: the effect is named after Raman, and the technique is called spectroscopy because the information still arrives as shifted lines.
senses.whyCN: 该效应以拉曼命名，方法仍称光谱学，因为信息依旧以偏移后的谱线传来。

senses.title: Infrared spectroscopy
senses.titleCN: 红外光谱法：读分子振动
senses.definition: the use of infrared absorption to identify the vibrational modes of chemical bonds
senses.definitionCN: 用红外吸收来识别化学键振动模式的方法
senses.example: Infrared spectroscopy showed a sharp band where the carbonyl group should be.
senses.exampleCN: 红外光谱法在羰基应有的位置显示出一条锐带。
senses.why: infrared photons carry exactly the energies that make bonds stretch and bend, so this band of the spectrum reads structure.
senses.whyCN: 红外光子携带的能量正好能让化学键伸缩弯曲，因此这一段光谱读的是结构。

senses.title: Nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy
senses.titleCN: 核磁共振波谱法：读原子核的共振
senses.definition: a technique that maps the chemical environment of atomic nuclei from their resonance in a magnetic field
senses.definitionCN: 借原子核在磁场中的共振来描绘其化学环境的方法
senses.example: NMR spectroscopy settled the shape of the molecule in a single afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 核磁共振波谱法在一个下午就确定了分子的形状。
senses.why: the resonance is driven by radio waves rather than light, yet the readout is still a spectrum of peaks, so the name travels.
senses.whyCN: 共振由射频波而非光驱动，读出的仍是峰组成的谱，因此这个名称照样适用。

senses.title: Abstract: resolving any whole into readable parts
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：把任何整体拆成可读成分的分析
senses.definition: any systematic reading that separates a complex whole into components that can be identified one by one
senses.definitionCN: 任何把复杂整体分成可逐一识别的成分的系统性解读
senses.example: The survey worked as spectroscopy on the tastes of a whole city.
senses.exampleCN: 这项调查像光谱分析一样，把一整座城的口味拆成可读的几条。
senses.why: the abstract sense keeps the shape of the method: a mixture is spread out until each ingredient can be named.
senses.whyCN: 抽象义保留了方法的形状：把混合物摊开，直到每种成分都能被叫出名字。

intro.en: Spectroscopy is spectrum plus the Greek suffix -skopia, the act of viewing. It grew out of the spectrum analysis of the 1860s and became a discipline of its own.
intro.cn: spectroscopy 是 spectrum 加希腊后缀 -skopia「观看之事」。它从 1860 年代的光谱分析中生长出来，随后成为一门独立学科。

items.en: Spectrum meant appearance or image in Latin, from specere to look; English took the word through optics after Newton.
items.cn: spectrum 在拉丁语中指「外观、影像」，出自 specere「看」；英语在牛顿之后经光学把它引入。

items.en: The suffix -skopia names the act of viewing, from skopein to look; it is the abstract partner of the instrument suffix -scope.
items.cn: 后缀 -skopia 指「观看之事」，出自 skopein「看」；它是仪器后缀 -scope 的抽象对应形式。

items.en: Bunsen and Kirchhoff established that lines identify elements, and the technique was first called spectrum analysis rather than spectroscopy.
items.cn: 本生与基尔霍夫确立了谱线可识别元素，当时这项技术先被称为光谱分析，而非光谱学。

items.en: As infrared, Raman and nuclear magnetic resonance methods multiplied, spectroscopy became the general name for all of them.
items.cn: 随着红外、拉曼与核磁共振方法增多，spectroscopy 成了统称。

items.en: Spectrometry stresses measurement and spectroscopy stresses the reading of spectra, though working scientists often use the two interchangeably.
items.cn: spectrometry 强调测量，spectroscopy 强调读取光谱，不过实际工作者常把二者混用。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and deeper origin): the change from spectrum analysis to spectroscopy has no single documented first use, and the pre-Latin origin of specere is unsettled, so any Indo-European root offered is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词源）：从「光谱分析」到「光谱学」的称谓变化没有唯一的文献首用记录；specere 在拉丁语之前的来源亦无定论，凡提出的印欧词根均属重构形式。

note.en: Group one holds the near-identical names that split the work of viewing, recording and measuring; group two holds neighbouring analytical techniques.
note.cn: 第一组是名称几乎相同、却把观看、记录与测量分工开来的词；第二组是相邻的分析方法。

entries.definition: The physical device for viewing a spectrum; spectroscopy is the method and the field, not the object on the bench.
entries.definitionCN: 用于观看光谱的实体装置；spectroscopy 是方法与学科，不是台面上的那件东西。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning relating to spectral observation, as in spectroscopic data; it cannot name the discipline.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，意为「与光谱观察有关的」，如光谱数据；它不能指这门学科本身。

entries.definition: The measurement of spectra, built on metron measure; it overlaps spectroscopy but leans on quantities.
entries.definitionCN: 对光谱的测量，出自 metron「测量」；与光谱学重叠，但偏重量化。

entries.definition: The practice of recording spectra on film or detectors, built on graphein write.
entries.definitionCN: 把光谱记录在底片或探测器上的做法，出自 graphein「写」。

entries.definition: The older phrase for the same work, still used when the emphasis is on identifying a sample rather than on the field.
entries.definitionCN: 同一工作的旧称，在强调鉴定样品而非学科本身时仍在使用。

entries.definition: The measurement of light intensity without resolving wavelength; it gives totals, not lines.
entries.definitionCN: 不区分波长地测量光强；给出总量，不给谱线。

entries.definition: The measurement of radiant energy across the whole electromagnetic range, including invisible bands.
entries.definitionCN: 跨越整个电磁波段（含不可见波段）测量辐射能量。

entries.definition: A laboratory method that separates a mixture into components by how fast each moves; different tool, similar goal.
entries.definitionCN: 按各成分移动快慢把混合物分开的实验室方法；工具不同，目标相近。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real techniques and real instrument names that differ by suffix.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实语素、真实技术，以及只靠后缀区分的真实仪器名称。

normal.en: spectro- plus -scopy: the suffix -scopy names the activity, while -scope names the instrument.
normal.cn: spectro- 加 -scopy：后缀 -scopy 指活动，-scope 指仪器。

normal.en: The main branches are named by the band or effect: infrared, Raman, NMR.
normal.cn: 主要分支按波段或效应命名：红外、拉曼、核磁共振。

normal.en: Absorption reads gaps; emission reads bright lines.
normal.cn: 吸收法读缺口，发射法读亮线。

normal.en: Astronomical spectroscopy is the only way to weigh a star without visiting it.
normal.cn: 天文光谱学是不亲临恒星而测量它的唯一途径。

normal.en: The adjective is spectroscopic and the worker is a spectroscopist.
normal.cn: 形容词是 spectroscopic，从业者叫 spectroscopist。

abstract.en: Picture a choir where every voice is given its own line on a page.
abstract.cn: 想象一个合唱团，每条嗓子在纸面上都分到自己的那一行。

abstract.en: Picture a fingerprint made of light rather than skin.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚用光而不是皮肤印出的指纹。

abstract.en: Picture a locked room that will only answer in wavelengths.
abstract.cn: 想象一间上锁的屋子，只肯用波长来回答。

examples.en: Infrared spectroscopy is routine in every organic chemistry laboratory.
examples.cn: 红外光谱法是每个有机化学实验室的常规手段。

examples.en: The new telescope was built chiefly for spectroscopy of faint galaxies.
examples.cn: 这台新望远镜主要建造用于暗弱星系的光谱分析。

examples.en: Her doctorate is in molecular spectroscopy rather than optics.
examples.cn: 她的博士学位研究方向是分子光谱学，而不是光学。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「spectro（光谱）+ scopy（观看之术）」——专门观看光谱的学问 → 光谱学

root: 拉丁 spectrum「外观、影像」（出自 specere「看」）+ 希腊 -skopia「观看之事」（出自 skopein「看」）；两处更早来源均不确定。英语 spectroscopy。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from the discipline itself to its astronomical use, then through absorption, emission, Raman, infrared and resonance methods, and end with the method as a metaphor.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从学科本身走向天文应用，再依次经过吸收、发射、拉曼、红外与共振各类方法，最后以方法的比喻义收尾。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: light laid out in lines that can be read like a printed code.
core.cn: 核心意象：光被摊成一行行谱线，可以像印刷代码一样读取。

branches.en: DISCIPLINE: the suffix -scopy turns one act of looking into a field of study.
branches.cn: 学科：后缀 -scopy 把一次观看的动作变成一门研究领域。

branches.en: DISTANT OBJECTS: starlight is the only sample astronomy can obtain.
branches.cn: 遥远对象：星光是天文学唯一能取得的样品。

branches.en: TWO DIRECTIONS: absorption reads what is missing, emission reads what is sent out.
branches.cn: 两个方向：吸收读缺少的部分，发射读放出的部分。

branches.en: SCATTERED AND INFRARED: shifted lines and bond vibrations widen the range of readable matter.
branches.cn: 散射与红外：偏移的谱线与化学键振动扩大了可读物质的范围。

branches.en: RESONANCE AND METAPHOR: even nuclei yield peaks, and any mixture can be spread out to be read.
branches.cn: 共振与比喻：连原子核也能给出峰，而任何混合物都可摊开来读。

intro.en: Spectroscopy is spectrum plus an abstract Greek suffix, and the same suffix contrasts neatly with the instrument suffix -scope.
intro.cn: spectroscopy 是 spectrum 加一个抽象希腊后缀，这个后缀与仪器后缀 -scope 形成整齐对照。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies spectrum and specere; Greek supplies skopein and -skopia. The abstract noun is later than the instrument noun.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁提供 spectrum 与 specere，希腊提供 skopein 与 -skopia；抽象名词晚于仪器名词出现。

items.example: The prefix ties every technique to spectra.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把每种技术都系在光谱上。

items.meaning: the act or method of viewing
items.example: The suffix names a method rather than a device.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀命名的是方法，而非装置。
光谱学认出了这种元素。
光谱学证据支持了这一说法。
这种气体被以光谱方法探测到。

items.example: The spectroscope showed the bands directly.
items.exampleCN: 分光镜直接显示出条带。
光谱测量给出了精确的强度。
摄谱记录保住了那些暗弱谱线。

latinEntries.meaning: the older name of the method

definition_zh: 观察法；观察方法
definition_en: a research procedure in which behaviour, events or settings are watched and recorded systematically rather than reported afterwards
core_image: 教室后排坐着记录员，手里一张按时间段分格的观察表，窗台放着计时器
scene: 教室后排，记录员不开口，只按时间段在表格里画勾，孩子们的活动被一格一格记下。 The study relies on the observation method to record how children share materials.
sceneCN: 这里指系统的观察法（第 1 个义项：以系统观看记录行为的研究方法）；句意为这项研究依靠观察法记录儿童如何分享材料。图中可辨识物件：观察表、计时器、铅笔、教室桌椅、积木。

collocations.phrase: the limits of the observation method

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语 observare 经法语而来，义为「观察；遵守」
由观察动词加表示动作的名词尾构成，义为「观察」
由观察动词加表示施动者的词尾构成，义为「观察者」
由希腊语 methodos 经拉丁语而来，义为「方法」
由该名词加表示「学问」的词尾构成，义为「方法论」

senses.title: Systematic watching as a research procedure
senses.titleCN: 作为研究程序的系统观察
senses.definition: a planned procedure in which a trained observer watches behaviour and records it under fixed rules
senses.definitionCN: 受过训练的观察者按固定规则观看并记录行为的计划性程序
senses.example: The study relies on the observation method to record how children share materials.
senses.exampleCN: 这项研究依靠观察法记录儿童如何分享材料。
senses.why: Watching becomes a method only when the time, place and categories of recording are decided in advance.
senses.whyCN: 只有当时间、地点与记录类别都预先确定，观看才成为方法。

senses.title: Participant observation
senses.definition: a form in which the researcher joins the setting and takes part in its ordinary activities while observing
senses.definitionCN: 研究者进入场景并参与日常活动，同时进行观察的形式
senses.example: The observation method can be participant, with the researcher joining the shift as a trainee.
senses.exampleCN: 观察法可以是参与式的，研究者以受训者身份加入班组。
senses.why: Some settings close themselves to outsiders, so access depends on becoming a member.
senses.whyCN: 有些场景对外人关闭，进入的代价就是先成为成员。

senses.title: Non-participant observation
senses.definition: a form in which the researcher stays outside the activity and watches without joining it
senses.definitionCN: 研究者留在活动之外观看而不加入的形式
senses.example: A non-participant observation method keeps the researcher outside the group.
senses.exampleCN: 非参与式观察法让研究者留在群体之外。
senses.why: Distance protects the setting from disturbance, but it also removes the observer from the participants' own meanings.
senses.whyCN: 距离使场景免受打扰，但也让观察者远离参与者自己的意义世界。

senses.title: Naturalistic observation
senses.definition: observation of behaviour in its ordinary setting, with as little interference as the research allows
senses.definitionCN: 在尽可能少干预的情况下，于日常情境中观察行为
senses.example: The observation method works best when the setting is left undisturbed.
senses.exampleCN: 当场景不受打扰时，观察法效果最好。
senses.why: If the aim is to know what people do when not watched, the setting must stay as it normally is.
senses.whyCN: 如果目的是了解人们不被观察时会怎么做，场景就必须维持原样。

senses.title: Structured observation
senses.definition: observation guided by a fixed checklist, category system or time sampling scheme
senses.definitionCN: 由固定清单、类别系统或时间抽样方案引导的观察
senses.example: A structured observation method uses a fixed checklist of categories.
senses.exampleCN: 结构化观察法使用固定的类别清单。
senses.why: Comparable records across observers require the same categories and the same sampling intervals.
senses.whyCN: 要让不同观察者的记录可比，就需要相同类别与相同时间间隔。

senses.title: Controlled or laboratory observation
senses.titleCN: 受控观察或实验室观察
senses.definition: observation arranged in a controlled setting so that conditions can be held constant
senses.definitionCN: 在受控场景中安排观察，使条件保持恒定
senses.example: The observation method may move into a laboratory when control is needed.
senses.exampleCN: 需要控制条件时，观察法可以移入实验室。
senses.why: Some behaviours are too brief or too rare to wait for in the field, so the setting is staged.
senses.whyCN: 有些行为太短或太罕见，在现场等不到，于是场景被安排出来。

senses.title: Classroom or clinical observation
senses.definition: the professional use of systematic watching to document participation, progress or symptoms
senses.definitionCN: 专业人员用系统观看记录参与度、进展或症状的做法
senses.example: Teachers use the observation method to document classroom participation.
senses.exampleCN: 教师用观察法记录课堂参与情况。
senses.why: Practice needs evidence that is not drawn from a single test score, so watching is written into routine records.
senses.whyCN: 实践需要不来自单次测验分数的证据，于是观看被写进日常记录。

senses.title: The limits of observation as evidence
senses.definition: the methodological problems of reactivity, observer drift, sampling of occasions and reliability
senses.definitionCN: 反应性、观察者漂移、情境取样与可靠性等方法问题
senses.example: The observation method is weakened when the observer's presence changes behaviour.
senses.exampleCN: 当观察者的在场改变行为时，观察法就被削弱。
senses.why: A method that records behaviour also becomes part of the situation it records, and that is its central weakness.
senses.whyCN: 记录行为的方法本身也成为被记录情境的一部分，这正是它的核心弱点。

intro.en: Observation method joins Latin observare, to watch or keep, to Greek methodos, a way of pursuit. The compound is a modern research label rather than an old word.
intro.cn: 这个术语把拉丁语 observare「观看、留意」与希腊语 methodos「追寻之路」组合起来，是现代研究标签而非古老词。

items.en: Observare meant to watch over, keep or pay attention to, built from ob- toward and servare to keep.
items.cn: observare 意为看守、留意、注意，由 ob-「朝向」加 servare「保持」构成。

items.en: Observatio named the act of watching and also the respect paid to a rule.
items.cn: observatio 既指观看行为，也指对规则的遵守。

items.en: English adopted observation for careful noticing; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语用 observation 表示仔细留意；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Methodos meant a way of pursuit, from meta after or along and hodos a road.
items.cn: methodos 意为追寻之路，由 meta「沿着」与 hodos「道路」构成。

items.en: Latin took the Greek word into learned usage, and English received method through French.
items.cn: 拉丁语把这个希腊词带入学术用法，英语再经法语得到 method。

items.en: Social research joined the two nouns to name watching done under explicit rules.
items.cn: 社会科学把这两个名词组合，指在明确规则下进行的观看。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like observation method; the second group names neighbouring ways of studying a setting.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与本术语相近；第二组是与「研究场景」意思相邻的做法。

entries.definition: To watch or notice deliberately.
entries.definitionCN: 指有意观看或留意。

entries.definition: The person who watches and records.
entries.definitionCN: 指观看并记录的人。

entries.definition: The keeping of a rule or ritual, from the same Latin verb.
entries.definitionCN: 指遵守规则或仪式，出自同一拉丁动词。

entries.definition: A planned way of doing something.
entries.definitionCN: 指有计划的做法。

entries.definition: The study of methods rather than a single method.
entries.definitionCN: 指对方法的研究，而非某一具体方法。

entries.definition: Long-term study of a group through immersion and field notes.
entries.definitionCN: 指通过长期沉浸与田野笔记研究一个群体。

entries.definition: Research carried out in the setting where the activity occurs.
entries.definitionCN: 指在活动发生的场景中开展的研究。

entries.definition: Repeated checking of conditions, often for management rather than research.
entries.definitionCN: 指反复检查状况，常为管理而非研究。

entries.definition: Detailed examination of one case or a few cases.
entries.definitionCN: 指对一个或少数个案的细致考察。

entries.definition: A fixed list of items used to standardise recording.
entries.definitionCN: 指用于统一记录的固定条目清单。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations work through the real parts, word family and common phrases behind this term.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想依托这个术语背后真实的构词部件、同族词与常见搭配。

normal.en: The word begins with watching and ends with a road, which is exactly what a method is: a watched path.
normal.cn: 这个词以「观看」开头、以「道路」结尾，方法正是这样一条被看着的路。

normal.en: Participant and non-participant are the two chairs an observer may take.
normal.cn: 参与与非参与是观察者可以坐的两把椅子。

normal.en: A checklist turns watching into comparable ticks across observers.
normal.cn: 清单把观看变成不同观察者之间可比的勾选。

normal.en: Reactivity is the name for the change a watched person makes in response to being watched.
normal.cn: 反应性指被观察者因被观看而作出的改变。

normal.en: Observer drift is the slow change in how one person applies the same categories over time.
normal.cn: 观察者漂移指同一个人随着时间推移对相同类别的判定发生缓慢变化。

abstract.en: The observer is a measuring instrument that cannot be calibrated once and left alone.
abstract.cn: 观察者是一件无法一次校准就永久使用的测量仪器。

abstract.en: A method that watches people also teaches them how to be watched.
abstract.cn: 观看人的方法同时也在教他们如何被观看。

abstract.en: The record is not the event; it is the event after it has passed through one pair of eyes.
abstract.cn: 记录不是事件本身，而是事件穿过一双眼睛之后的样子。

examples.en: The observation method requires a clear definition of each behaviour category.
examples.cn: 观察法要求对每个行为类别给出清晰定义。

examples.en: She compared the observation method with interviews in the same classroom.
examples.cn: 她在同一间教室里比较了观察法与访谈。

examples.en: Training reduced observer drift in the observation method.
examples.cn: 培训减少了观察法中的观察者漂移。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「观察」加「方法」——看什么、何时看、怎么记，三件事定死，观看才变成研究。

root: 拉丁 observare「看守、留意」← ob-「朝向」+ servare「保持」，名词 observatio；希腊 methodos「追寻之路」← meta「沿着」+ hodos「道路」，经拉丁 methodus 与法语进入英语；两词组合为现代研究术语。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from the general procedure to its variants and limits: systematic watching, participant and non-participant forms, naturalistic and structured observation, controlled settings, professional use, and methodological weaknesses.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从一般程序走向各种形式与局限：系统观看、参与与非参与、自然情境与结构化、受控场景、专业应用，以及方法弱点。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a recorder sits at the back of a room with a grid sheet divided by time intervals, ticking what happens in each cell.
core.cn: 核心意象：记录员坐在房间后排，手持按时间分格的表格，在每一格里勾下发生的事。

branches.en: THE PROCEDURE: watching turned into a method by prior rules.
branches.cn: 程序：通过预先规则把观看变成方法。

branches.en: THE TWO POSITIONS: inside the group or outside it.
branches.cn: 两种位置：群体之内或群体之外。

branches.en: THE SETTING: left undisturbed, or arranged for control.
branches.cn: 场景：保持原样，或为控制而布置。

branches.en: THE RECORDING PRACTICE: checklists for comparison, and routine professional documentation.
branches.cn: 记录实践：为比较而用清单，以及日常专业记录。

branches.en: THE WEAKNESS: the observer becomes part of what is observed.
branches.cn: 弱点：观察者成为被观察对象的一部分。

intro.en: The phrase is two complete words: a Latin-derived noun for watching and a Greek-derived noun for a way.
intro.cn: 这个短语是两个完整单词：拉丁来源的「观看」名词与希腊来源的「道路」名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies observare and servare for the first half, Greek supplies methodos and hodos for the second; English endings and compounding do the joining.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语为前半提供 observare 与 servare，希腊语为后半提供 methodos 与 hodos；英语词尾与复合构词完成连接。

items.example: It directs attention toward the object watched.
items.exampleCN: 它把注意力引向被观看的对象。

items.example: Watching is framed as keeping something under care.
items.exampleCN: 观看被框定为对某物的看守。

items.structure: Latin verb from ob- plus servare
items.example: The verb supplies the first half of the term.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供术语的前半。

items.example: The noun carries both attention and compliance.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词同时带有注意与遵守。

items.example: It marks pursuit along a path.
The second half begins with a road.

items.structure: Greek noun from meta plus hodos
items.example: The Greek word became Latin methodus and English method.
items.exampleCN: 这个希腊词变成拉丁 methodus 与英语 method。

items.example: The compound is a modern research label.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词是现代研究标签。

latinEntries.structure: methodus, methodi (f., second declension, from Greek methodos)

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语 observare 经法语而来，义为「观察；遵守」
由观察动词加表示动作的名词尾构成，义为「观察」

definition_zh: n. 极乐，狂喜；至福
definition_en: perfect happiness; a state of complete content with nothing left to want
core_image: 怀里抱着熟睡的孩子，屋里只听见炉火的轻响
scene: 孩子在她怀里睡熟了，那一刻她只觉得无比幸福。 Holding the sleeping child, she felt pure bliss.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：bliss 指毫无缺憾的极致幸福；句意是抱着熟睡的孩子，她感到纯粹的幸福。

forms.label: 不可数名词（无屈折变化）

senses.title: Perfect happiness
senses.definition: complete and untroubled happiness, with nothing wanted and nothing feared
senses.definitionCN: 完全无忧的幸福，无所求也无所惧
senses.example: A hot bath after a cold walk is bliss.
senses.exampleCN: 冷天走一遭之后泡个热水澡，就是极乐。
senses.why: Old English bliss comes from blīthe, gentle and glad, the same root as blithe.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 bliss 来自 blīthe（温和、喜悦），与 blithe 同根。

senses.title: The joy of heaven
senses.definition: in religious writing, the eternal joy of heaven
senses.definitionCN: 宗教文字中天堂的永恒之乐
senses.example: The hymn speaks of souls entering bliss.
senses.exampleCN: 这首赞美诗说到灵魂进入至福。
senses.why: Religious language took the strongest word for happiness and made it permanent.
senses.whyCN: 宗教语言取用最强的「幸福」一词，并让它成为永恒。

intro.en: Bliss descends from Old English blīthe, gentle and glad, the same word that became blithe.
intro.cn: bliss 源自中古英语之前的 blīthe（温和、喜悦），与 blithe 同出一词。

items.en: Blīthe means gentle, kind and glad.
items.cn: blīthe 意为温和、亲切、喜悦。

items.en: Blīths turns that gladness into a noun.
items.cn: blīths 把这份喜悦变成名词。

items.en: English bliss names perfect gladness.
items.cn: 英语 bliss 指完满的喜悦。

items.en: Preachers use bliss for the joy of heaven.
items.cn: 布道者用 bliss 指天国之乐。

items.en: Wedded bliss and domestic bliss become fixed phrases.
items.cn: wedded bliss 与 domestic bliss 成为固定说法。

items.en: Everyday speech uses bliss for small intense pleasures.
items.cn: 日常口语用 bliss 指小而强烈的愉悦。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the bl- plus s shape; the near-meaning group ranks happiness from delight to religious ecstasy.
note.cn: 形近组保留 bl- 加 s 的形状；近义组把幸福从欣喜排到宗教式的狂喜。

entries.definition: Cheerful and carefree.
entries.definitionCN: 快活无忧的。

entries.definition: To ask divine favour for someone.
entries.definitionCN: 为某人祈求神恩。

entries.definition: A sudden intensive attack.
entries.definitionCN: 突如其来的猛烈攻击。

entries.definition: A small bubble on the skin.
entries.definitionCN: 皮肤上的水疱。

entries.definition: A feeling of great pleasure.
entries.definitionCN: 强烈的愉悦感。

entries.definition: Great pleasure in something.
entries.definitionCN: 对某事的高度愉悦。

entries.definition: A feeling of intense delight.
entries.definitionCN: 忘我的极度喜悦。

entries.definition: An overwhelming feeling of happiness.
entries.definitionCN: 压倒一切的幸福感。

normalIntro.en: Bliss is the noun hiding inside blithe: the gladness itself, without the adjective.
normalIntro.cn: bliss 是藏在 blithe 里的名词：那份喜悦本身，去掉了形容词。

normal.en: Blithe is the adjective, bliss the noun.
normal.cn: blithe 是形容词，bliss 是名词。

normal.en: Both come from one old word for gentle gladness.
normal.cn: 两者都来自一个表示温和喜悦的古词。

normal.en: Bliss is happiness with nothing left to want.
normal.cn: bliss 是再无所求的幸福。

normal.en: Preachers made it mean heaven.
normal.cn: 布道者让它指天堂。

normal.en: A hot bath, a sleeping child: small bliss.
normal.cn: 一个热水澡、一个睡着的孩子：小小的极乐。

abstract.en: Happiness with no edge of worry.
abstract.cn: 不带一丝忧虑的幸福。

abstract.en: A moment that asks for nothing next.
abstract.cn: 不要求「然后」的一刻。

abstract.en: Gladness at full, with the tap closed.
abstract.cn: 喜悦满到顶，水龙头已关。

examples.en: The first coffee of the morning is pure bliss.
examples.cn: 早上第一杯咖啡就是纯粹的幸福。

examples.en: They spent a blissful week doing nothing at all.
examples.cn: 他们无所事事地度过了极其幸福的一周。

examples.en: The old hymn describes the bliss of the saved.
examples.cn: 这首古老的赞美诗描述了得救者的至福。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不理事」——幸福到极点时，什么事都不必理，躺着就好。

root: 古英语 blīthe（温和、喜悦）→ blīths（喜悦，名词）；与 blithe 同源

sensesIntro.en: Everyday bliss is a small perfect moment; religious bliss is that same moment made eternal.
sensesIntro.cn: 日常的 bliss 是小小的完满瞬间；宗教的 bliss 是把这瞬间变成永恒。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sleeping child in warm arms with the fire ticking
core.cn: 核心意象：壁炉轻响，孩子熟睡在温暖的怀里

branches.en: A first sip of hot coffee.
branches.cn: 第一口热咖啡。

branches.en: A quiet house after the guests leave.
branches.cn: 客人走后的安静屋子。

branches.en: A hymn about souls at rest.
branches.cn: 关于安息灵魂的赞美诗。

branches.en: Light that never goes out.
branches.cn: 永不熄灭的光。

branches.en: Gladness with nothing to interrupt it.
branches.cn: 没有任何事来打断的喜悦。

intro.en: Bliss is a noun that mostly grows adjectives; the list below builds its family and the vocabulary of intense joy.
intro.cn: bliss 是个主要派生形容词的名词；下面列出它的词族与「强烈喜悦」词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin gaudium is joy, laetitia is gladness, and beare is to bless.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 gaudium 意为喜悦，laetitia 意为欢欣，beare 意为祝福。

laetitia 产生 delight 与 elation。

definition_zh: n. 毛毛雨；细雨 v. 下毛毛雨；（烹饪）淋；洒
definition_en: very fine rain in tiny drops, to fall as such rain, or to pour a thin stream of liquid over food
core_image: 灰蒙蒙的天里飘着几乎看不见的细水珠，眼镜片蒙上一层小点，路面只发亮却不积水；另一头一只手把瓶子倾斜，橄榄油从瓶口拉成一条细线淋在沙拉上
scene: 天空灰得像蒙了纱，细水珠落在镜片上变成一层小点，路面只发亮却不积水。 A cold drizzle fell on the town all afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里 drizzle 是「毛毛雨」（第 1 个义项：极细小水珠的雨）；句意是冰冷的细雨整个下午落在镇上。图中可辨识物件：灰纱般的天空、蒙雾的镜片、发亮而无水洼的路面。

derivatives.zh: 细雨蒙蒙的；潮湿阴沉的

senses.title: Very fine rain
senses.definition: rain falling in many very small drops
senses.definitionCN: （名词）以极细小水珠落下的雨
senses.example: A cold drizzle fell on the town all afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 冰冷的细雨整个下午落在镇上。
senses.why: Grey air full of tiny beads that fog a pair of glasses instead of splashing.
senses.whyCN: 灰色的空气里满是细小水珠，把眼镜蒙上一层雾而不是溅起水花。

senses.title: To rain lightly
senses.definition: to rain lightly and steadily in very small drops
senses.definitionCN: （动词）以极细小水珠轻而持续地下雨
senses.example: It had been drizzling since dawn, so the pitch stayed soft.
senses.exampleCN: 从黎明起就一直下毛毛雨，所以球场一直是软的。
senses.why: A pavement that only shines, with no puddle anywhere on it.
senses.whyCN: 路面只是发亮，上面一处水洼也没有。

senses.title: Pour a thin thread
senses.definition: to pour a thin stream of liquid over food
senses.definitionCN: （动词）把液体成细线淋在食物上
senses.example: Drizzle the warm dressing over the leaves just before serving.
senses.exampleCN: 上桌前把温热的调味汁淋在菜叶上。
senses.why: A bottle tipped so that oil leaves the mouth as one thin shining thread.
senses.whyCN: 瓶子倾斜，油从瓶口拉成一条细亮的线。

intro.en: Drizzle is a frequentative built on an old verb meaning to fall: the ending repeats the action, so drizzle is falling again and again in the smallest drops.
intro.cn: drizzle 是在一个意为「落下」的古老动词上加反复体构成的：这个词尾让动作反复，所以 drizzle 就是以最细小的水珠一次次落下。

items.en: Old English dreosan means to fall.
items.cn: 古英语 dreosan 意为落下。

items.en: Middle English drusen means to fall in drops.
items.cn: 中古英语 drusen 意为成滴落下。

items.en: The frequentative form drizzle appears for very fine rain.
items.cn: 反复体形式 drizzle 出现，指极细的雨。

items.en: The adjective drizzly describes weather of fine steady rain.
items.cn: 形容词 drizzly 用来描述细雨连绵的天气。

items.en: Cookery books use drizzle for pouring a thin stream over a dish.
items.cn: 烹饪书用 drizzle 表示把细流淋在菜上。

items.en: The word stays the standard term for the lightest kind of rain.
items.cn: 这个词仍是最轻一类雨的标准说法。

note.en: Drizzle shares its busy ending with dazzle and grizzle, while its neighbours name other light ways of wetting a surface.
note.cn: drizzle 与 dazzle、grizzle 共用那个细碎的词尾，而它的近义词则是别的把表面弄湿的轻方式。

dict_mnemonic.text: drizzle ＝ 古英语 drēosan（落下）＋ 反复后缀 -le ＝「一次次细细地落」。所以它不是 shower（阵雨）也不是 downpour（暴雨），而是几乎看不见水珠、只把路面弄亮的毛毛雨。厨房里的 drizzle with oil 是同一画面：把油拉成一条细线淋下去。同族的 mizzle 是「雾＋细雨」，形容词 drizzly 说的是那种整天阴湿的天气。

senses.title: A sun-dried clay brick
senses.definition: a brick made of clay mixed with straw or dung, shaped in a mold and hardened by the sun rather than by fire
senses.definitionCN: 用黏土掺草或粪料、在模具中成型、靠日晒而非火烧变硬的砖
senses.example: The workers laid adobe bricks in rows to dry.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们把土坯砖成排摆开晾晒。
senses.why: The word names the single unit first: the brick you can pick up is the most concrete thing the term can point to.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最先指的是单个单位：能拿在手里的那块砖，是这个词能指的最具体的东西。

senses.title: The building material as a mass
senses.definition: the clay-and-straw mixture used as a building material, treated as an uncountable mass
senses.definitionCN: 用作建筑材料的黏土与草料混合物，作不可数物质名词
senses.example: The floor was packed with adobe taken from the riverbank.
senses.exampleCN: 地面用从河岸取来的土坯料夯成。
senses.why: From single bricks the word moves to the substance they are made of, the way brick can mean both one block and the material.
senses.whyCN: 从单块砖出发，这个词又指做砖的物质，正如 brick 既可指一块砖，也可指砖这种材料。

senses.title: A building made of adobe
senses.definition: a house or other structure whose walls are built of adobe
senses.definitionCN: 墙体用土坯砌成的房屋或其他建筑
senses.example: They restored the adobe at the end of the street.
senses.exampleCN: 他们修复了街尾那栋土坯房。
senses.why: A material can stand for the thing made from it; here the walls are so much the identity of the building that the substance becomes its name.
senses.whyCN: 材料可以代指用它做成的东西；在这里墙体几乎就是建筑的身份，于是材料名成了建筑名。

senses.title: The raw clay mixture
senses.definition: the wet clay mixture, before shaping and drying, from which adobe bricks are made
senses.definitionCN: 尚未成型晾干、用来制土坯砖的湿黏土混合物
senses.example: Straw was folded into the adobe to stop it cracking.
senses.exampleCN: 人们把草料揉进制坯黏土里，防止它开裂。
senses.why: This is the material one step earlier in time, still soft and shapeless, before the sun gives it a form.
senses.whyCN: 这是时间上更早一步的材料，还软着、没有形状，等着太阳给它一个形态。

senses.title: Adobe as an architectural style
senses.definition: the style of construction associated with adobe, common in dry regions of the Americas and the Middle East
senses.definitionCN: 与土坯相关的一种建造风格，常见于美洲干旱地区与中东
senses.example: The hotel imitates the adobe of the American Southwest.
senses.exampleCN: 这家旅馆模仿美国西南部的土坯建筑风格。
senses.why: When a material becomes regional, its name can label a whole way of building rather than a single wall.
senses.whyCN: 当一种材料带上了地域色彩，它的名字就能标记一整套建造方式，而不只是一面墙。

senses.title: The regional building tradition
senses.definition: the craft and tradition of building with earth, tied to dry climates and communities with limited timber
senses.definitionCN: 与干旱气候、木材匮乏的社区相联系的夯土建造技艺与传统
senses.example: Adobe is still a living tradition in many desert villages.
senses.exampleCN: 在许多沙漠村落，土坯建造仍是活着的传统。
senses.why: The word carries a climate behind it: where rain and fuel are scarce, sun and earth do the work of kiln and timber.
senses.whyCN: 这个词背后带着一种气候：在雨水与燃料稀缺的地方，太阳和泥土代替了窑炉与木材。

senses.title: Unfired brick, as opposed to fired brick
senses.titleCN: 未经烧制的砖（区别于烧结砖）
senses.definition: brick hardened by air and sun alone, contrasted with brick fired in a kiln
senses.definitionCN: 仅靠空气与日晒变硬的砖，与窑中烧制的砖相对
senses.example: Adobe is cheaper than fired brick but far less resistant to rain.
senses.exampleCN: 土坯比烧结砖便宜，但耐雨性差得多。
senses.why: The defining contrast is the absence of fire: what makes the material adobe is exactly what has not been done to it.
senses.whyCN: 定义性的对照是「没有火」：这种材料之所以是土坯，正因为它没有被火烧过。

senses.title: A plain, earthy image
senses.definition: in figurative use, the quality of being plain, earthy, and close to the ground, as in an adobe-colored landscape
senses.definitionCN: 用于比喻时指朴素、土气、贴近大地的质感，如土坯色的风景
senses.example: The whole town seemed washed in adobe light at dusk.
senses.exampleCN: 黄昏时整座小镇仿佛被土坯色的光洗过。
senses.why: A material named after mud carries the feel of mud: warm, matte, low to the ground, and unpolished.
senses.whyCN: 以泥土得名的材料带着泥土的质感：温暖、哑光、贴近地面、不加修饰。

intro.en: Adobe is not a Latin word at all: it travelled from Egyptian through Coptic and Arabic into Spanish, and only then into English.
intro.cn: adobe 根本不是拉丁词：它从埃及语经科普特语、阿拉伯语进入西班牙语，最后才进入英语。

items.en: Egyptian recorded a word for brick written with the consonants db; the exact vowels are uncertain because the script omits them.
items.cn: 埃及语有一个表示「砖」的词，书写只留辅音 db；由于文字不标元音，确切读音不确定。

items.en: Coptic tōbe continued the Egyptian word and meant 'brick', the form that later speakers actually pronounced.
items.cn: 科普特语 tōbe 延续了埃及语的这个词，意为「砖」，这是后来使用者真正读出来的形式。

items.en: Arabic borrowed the word as ṭūb, and with the definite article it appears as al-ṭūb, 'the brick'.
items.cn: 阿拉伯语借入后作 ṭūb，加上定冠词则作 al-ṭūb，意为「那砖」。

items.en: Spanish took al-ṭūb and ran the article into the noun, giving adobe; the same thing happened to algebra and alcohol.
items.cn: 西班牙语借入 al-ṭūb 时把冠词并进了名词，得到 adobe；algebra 与 alcohol 也经历了同样的合并。

items.en: In Mexican Spanish adobe named the sun-dried brick of the region, and from there the building technique.
items.cn: 在墨西哥西班牙语中，adobe 指当地日晒而成的土砖，并由此指这种建造技术。

items.en: English adopted the word through American Spanish; early records describe the material in the American Southwest and Mexico.
items.cn: 英语经美洲西班牙语借入这个词；早期记录描述的是美国西南部与墨西哥的这种材料。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words that resemble adobe in sound or spelling but come from unrelated sources; the near-meaning group gathers earth-building materials and their units.
note.cn: 形近组收读音或拼写与 adobe 相近、但来源无关的词；近义组收泥土类建材及其单位。

entries.definition: A dwelling or home, from the verb abide, with no connection to clay.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「住所、家」，来自动词 abide，与泥土无关。

entries.definition: A Philippine and Latin American dish or marinade, from Spanish adobar, to marinate.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指菲律宾与拉美的腌渍菜或腌料，来自西班牙语 adobar「腌」。

entries.definition: An informal Southwestern American shortening of adobe, used for the material or a building.
entries.definitionCN: 美国西南部的口语缩略形式，指土坯材料或土坯房。

entries.definition: The fine-grained earth that is the main ingredient of adobe, before straw or shaping.
entries.definitionCN: 细粒泥土，是土坯的主要原料，尚未加草或成型。

entries.definition: A rectangular block used in building, whether fired, concrete, or sun-dried.
entries.definitionCN: 用于建造的长方块，可烧制、混凝土制或日晒而成，是土坯砖的上位词。

entries.definition: A mixture of clay, sand and straw used in earth building, but shaped by hand rather than in molds.
entries.definitionCN: 黏土、沙与草的混合物，也用于泥土建造，但用手塑形而非模具成型。

entries.definition: Fired clay used in building and sculpture, the kiln-made opposite of adobe.
entries.definitionCN: 经窑火烧制的陶土，用于建筑与雕塑，是土坯的「窑制」对立面。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the word's real travel route and the terms it actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用这个词真实的传播路线，以及它实际出现的说法。

normal.en: The Arabic article al- is still inside the word: al-ṭūb became adobe, just as al-jabr became algebra.
normal.cn: 阿拉伯语冠词 al- 还留在词里：al-ṭūb 变成 adobe，正如 al-jabr 变成 algebra。

normal.en: The same brick word reached Spanish and then English through Mexico.
normal.cn: 同一个「砖」词经墨西哥进入西班牙语，再进入英语。

normal.en: Adobe is dried by the sun, never fired in a kiln.
normal.cn: 土坯靠太阳晒干，从不在窑里烧。

normal.en: Adobe brick, adobe wall and adobe house are the three common compounds.
normal.cn: adobe brick、adobe wall 与 adobe house 是三个常见复合词。

normal.en: The word is tied to dry lands, where timber is scarce and sun is plentiful.
normal.cn: 这个词与干旱地区相连，那里木材稀缺、日照充足。

abstract.en: Picture a brick lying on hot sand with no kiln in sight: the sun is the only tool.
abstract.cn: 想象一块砖躺在滚烫的沙上，四下没有窑：太阳是唯一的工具。

abstract.en: The same lump of earth can be a wall, a house, a tradition or a color, depending on how far you step back.
abstract.cn: 同一团泥土可以是墙、是房子、是传统，也可以是一种颜色，取决于你退后多远看。

abstract.en: A material that needs no fire is a material that remembers the place it came from.
abstract.cn: 一种不需要火的材料，就是一种记得自己来自何处的材料。

examples.en: The old church is made entirely of adobe.
examples.cn: 这座老教堂完全由土坯建成。

examples.en: They mixed straw into the adobe to keep the walls from cracking.
examples.cn: 他们在土坯里掺入草料，防止墙体开裂。

examples.en: An adobe house stays cool in the desert heat.
examples.cn: 土坯房在沙漠的酷热中能保持凉爽。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿兜比」——阿兜一捧泥，晒成砖：土坯

root: 经西班牙语 adobe 来自阿拉伯语 al-ṭūb（那砖），更早可追至科普特语 tōbe 与埃及语表示「砖」的词；冠词 al- 并入了名词，故英语词首看似前缀而非前缀。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of adobe move from the single sun-dried brick to the material, the building, the raw mixture, the regional style, the tradition, the unfired contrast with kiln brick, and finally the plain earthy image.
sensesIntro.cn: adobe 的八个义项从单块日晒砖出发，依次扩展到材料、建筑、湿坯、地域风格、建造传统、与窑砖相对的不烧制特征，最后落到朴素土质的意象。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wet clay brick sits in a wooden mold under a hard sun, hardening without any fire.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块湿泥砖躺在木模里，烈日之下慢慢变硬，全程没有火。

branches.en: THE UNIT LINE: one brick, and specifically one that has dried in the sun rather than in a kiln.
branches.cn: 单位线：一块砖，且特指日晒而非窑烧而成的那一种。

branches.en: THE MATERIAL LINE: the mixture as a mass, first wet and shapeless, then set into a usable substance.
branches.cn: 材料线：作为物质的混合物，先是湿软无定形，后来定成可用的材料。

branches.en: THE BUILDING LINE: walls of adobe stand for the house they enclose.
branches.cn: 建筑线：土坯墙代指它所围起的房屋。

branches.en: THE REGION LINE: a material tied to dry climates becomes a style and a living craft.
branches.cn: 地域线：与干旱气候相连的材料，成为风格与活着的技艺。

branches.en: THE FEELING LINE: the color and texture of earth pass into a plain, unpolished image.
branches.cn: 质感线：泥土的颜色与质地转化为朴素、不加修饰的意象。

intro.en: Adobe has no English prefix or derivational suffix of its own: its parts are Arabic and Coptic, and English only adds a plural and compound nouns.
intro.cn: adobe 本身没有英语前缀或派生后缀：它的构件来自阿拉伯语与科普特语，英语只加了复数与复合名词。

latinIntro.en: Adobe has no Latin root at all; it reached English through Spanish from Arabic and Coptic, so this section lists no Latin relatives.
latinIntro.cn: adobe 完全没有拉丁词根；它经西班牙语来自阿拉伯语与科普特语，因此本栏不列拉丁同族词。

items.example: It was absorbed into the noun in Spanish.
items.exampleCN: 这个冠词在西班牙语中被并进了名词。

items.example: It is the Arabic form borrowed by Spanish.
items.exampleCN: 这是被西班牙语借入的阿拉伯语形式。

items.example: It continues the older Egyptian word.
items.exampleCN: 它延续了更早的埃及语词。

items.example: Egyptian writing gives the consonants only.

items.meaning: used before a noun to name an adobe thing
items.meaningCN: 用于名词前，表示土坯制成的
items.example: It forms adobe brick and adobe wall.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 adobe brick 与 adobe wall。

items.example: It is used in the American Southwest.
The compound names the single unit.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词指单个砖块。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 brick 构成，义为「土坯砖」
由本词加 house 构成，义为「土坯房」
由本词加 wall 构成，义为「土坯墙」

definition_zh: v. 逮捕；拘押；理解，领会；（正式或旧用）忧惧，预感不安
definition_en: To seize someone in the name of the law; in formal use, to grasp a meaning with the mind, or to look ahead to something with fear.
core_image: 伸手一把抓住：抓人、抓意思、抓住不祥的预感
scene: 警方在机场把嫌疑人抓住了。 Police apprehended the suspect at the airport.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：apprehend 在警务语境中指依法把人抓住、拘押，比 arrest 更书面。

senses.title: Seize in the name of the law
senses.definition: to catch and take hold of a person suspected of a crime, the formal police word for arrest
senses.definitionCN: 抓住并控制涉嫌犯罪的人，是 arrest 的正式警务说法
senses.example: Two officers apprehended him outside the station.
senses.exampleCN: 两名警员在车站外将他抓获。
senses.why: The root means seize, and the law simply supplies the reason for seizing, so the physical grip is still visible in the word.
senses.whyCN: 词根意为「抓住」，法律只是提供了抓的理由，所以这个词里仍看得见那只手的动作。

senses.title: Grasp with the mind
senses.definition: to understand or perceive something, especially a difficult idea, in formal or academic writing
senses.definitionCN: 理解或察觉某事，尤指难懂的概念，用于正式或学术文字
senses.example: Few readers apprehend the full force of that argument.
senses.exampleCN: 很少有读者能领会那一论证的全部分量。
senses.why: The same seizing is turned inward: instead of a hand closing on a person, the mind closes on a meaning.
senses.whyCN: 同样是「抓住」，只是转向内部：不是手合拢抓住人，而是头脑合拢抓住意思。

senses.title: Look ahead with fear
senses.definition: to anticipate something with anxiety or dread, an older formal sense surviving mainly in apprehensive
senses.definitionCN: 带着焦虑或恐惧预期某事，这一较旧的正式义主要存活在 apprehensive 中
senses.example: She apprehended trouble long before the letter arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 信还没到，她早就预感到有麻烦。
senses.why: Here the mind seizes something that has not happened yet, so grasping ahead turns into fearing ahead.
senses.whyCN: 这里头脑抓住的是尚未发生的事，于是「提前抓住」就变成了「提前害怕」。

intro.en: Apprehend comes from Latin apprehendere, to seize, built from ad-, to, and prehendere, to grasp, which is itself prae-, before, plus hendere, to take.
intro.cn: apprehend 来自拉丁语 apprehendere「抓住」，由 ad-「向」与 prehendere「抓握」构成，而 prehendere 本身又是 prae-「在前」加 hendere「取」。

items.en: Latin prae meant before or in front. In grasping, the hand goes out ahead of the body.
items.cn: 拉丁语 prae 意为「在前、向前」。抓东西时，手总是先伸到身体前面。

items.en: Hendere meant to take or seize, a root also seen in the Greek khandanein, to hold.
items.cn: hendere 意为「取、抓」，这一词根也见于希腊语 khandanein「握住」。

items.en: The two parts fused into prehendere, to lay hold of, the source of English prehensile, as in a monkey's tail.
items.cn: 两部分合成 prehendere「抓住」，它是英语 prehensile 的来源，例如形容猴子的卷尾。

items.en: Adding ad-, to, gave apprehendere, to seize upon, used for both taking a thing and taking an idea.
items.cn: 加上 ad-「向」得到 apprehendere「抓上去」，既用于抓实物，也用于抓概念。

items.en: English took the word in the fourteenth century, first for grasping with the mind and for dreading what is coming.
items.cn: 英语在 14 世纪吸收该词，起初指用头脑领会，以及忧惧将至之事。

items.en: By the sixteenth century the physical sense had narrowed to lawful seizure, which is why police reports still say apprehend.
items.cn: 到 16 世纪，实体义收窄为依法抓捕，因此警方通报至今仍用 apprehend。

note.en: The look-alike group sets apprehend beside comprehend, which only understands, and apprentice, which shares the same Latin root; the near-meaning group gives the everyday verbs.
note.cn: 形近组把 apprehend 与只表「理解」的 comprehend、以及同源的 apprentice 并列；近义组给出日常说法。

entries.definition: To understand fully.
entries.definitionCN: 完全理解。

entries.definition: Anxious about what may happen.
entries.definitionCN: 对可能发生的事感到不安。

entries.definition: A learner bound to a trade.
entries.definitionCN: 绑定学艺的学徒。

entries.definition: To inform someone of something.
entries.definitionCN: 把某事告知某人。

entries.definition: To take into police custody.
entries.definitionCN: 交由警方羁押。

entries.definition: To take hold of suddenly.
entries.definitionCN: 突然一把抓住。

entries.definition: To hold firmly, or to understand.
entries.definitionCN: 牢牢握住；或理解。

entries.definition: To keep someone in custody.
entries.definitionCN: 把某人羁押。

normalIntro.en: Apprehend is ap- plus prehend, to seize: seize a person, seize a meaning, or seize a fear before it arrives.
normalIntro.cn: apprehend 就是 ap- 加 prehend「抓」：抓人、抓意思，或在恐惧到来之前先抓住它。

normal.en: Police apprehend; ordinary speech says arrest.
normal.cn: 警方用 apprehend，日常口语说 arrest。

normal.en: The noun apprehension carries all three senses too.
normal.cn: 名词 apprehension 也带这三层意思。

normal.en: Apprehensive today means anxious, not understanding.
normal.cn: 如今 apprehensive 意为不安，不是「理解的」。

normal.en: Comprehend only understands; apprehend can also arrest.
normal.cn: comprehend 只表理解，apprehend 还能表逮捕。

normal.en: The root prehend also gives prehensile, a gripping tail.
normal.cn: 词根 prehend 还产生 prehensile，指能卷握的尾巴。

abstract.en: Picture a hand closing on a shoulder at a gate.
abstract.cn: 想象在登机口一只手扣住肩膀。

abstract.en: Imagine the mind closing on a difficult idea.
abstract.cn: 想象头脑合拢抓住一个难懂的概念。

abstract.en: Think of a shadow grabbed before it lands.
abstract.cn: 想象影子还没落地就先被抓住。

examples.en: The suspect was apprehended within an hour.
examples.cn: 嫌疑人一小时内就被抓获。

examples.en: A child apprehends a rule long before he can state it.
examples.cn: 孩子早就领会了规则，却还很说不出来。

examples.en: Investors apprehended a fall in prices.
examples.cn: 投资者预感到价格会下跌。

dict_mnemonic.text: 拆件记忆：ap-「向」+ prehend「抓」——伸手抓过去：抓人是逮捕，抓意思是理解，抓未来是忧惧。

root: 拉丁语 prae-「在前」加 hendere「取」成 prehendere「抓住」，再加 ad-「向」成 apprehendere；英语 14 世纪先取「领会、忧惧」，16 世纪收窄出「依法逮捕」。

sensesIntro.en: All three senses are one act of seizing: a hand on a suspect, a mind on a meaning, and a mind on a fear that has not arrived.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项是同一种「抓住」：手抓住嫌疑人，头脑抓住意思，以及头脑抓住尚未到来的恐惧。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand reaching out and closing, on a person, a meaning or a dread
core.cn: 核心意象：伸手一把抓住：抓人、抓意思、抓住不祥的预感

branches.en: Officers closing on a suspect at a gate.
branches.cn: 警员在登机口围住嫌疑人。

branches.en: A fugitive taken after two years.
branches.cn: 逃了两年后被抓的逃犯。

branches.en: A reader finally getting the argument.
branches.cn: 终于读懂论证的读者。

branches.en: Dread felt before the letter arrives.
branches.cn: 信未到就先感到的不安。

branches.en: Both seize something not yet in hand.
branches.cn: 两者抓住的都是还没到手的东西。

intro.en: Apprehend joins ap-, prae- and the seize root hend-/prehens-, which also builds comprehend, prehensile and apprentice.
intro.cn: apprehend 拼合了 ap-、prae- 与「抓」词根 hend-/prehens-，同一词根还构成 comprehend、prehensile 与 apprentice。

latinIntro.en: The Latin layer is hendere, prehendere and apprehendere; the same family gives the adjective prehensilis, able to grip.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语层次是 hendere、prehendere 与 apprehendere；同族还给出形容词 prehensilis「能抓握的」。

latinEntries.exampleCN: hendere 是 prehend 的来源。
prae 是 prehendere 的开头。

definition_zh: 金融家；财政家；为大型项目或企业提供资金的人
definition_en: a person who manages large sums of money, invests in enterprises or provides funding for projects
core_image: 一位穿深色外套的人坐在长桌一端，面前摊着多家公司的账目与融资方案
scene: 铁路公司靠少数几个出资人筹到建线所需的巨款。 A financier arranged the loan that kept the railway company alive.
sceneCN: 此处指「为大型项目或企业提供资金的人」（第 3 个义项：为企业出资者）；句意为一位金融家安排了让铁路公司得以存续的贷款。图中可辨识物件：长桌、融资方案、铁路地图、贷款合同。

pos.zh: 为项目或企业提供资金的人

senses.title: A person who deals in large sums
senses.titleCN: 从事大额资金业务的人
senses.definition: a person whose business is the handling and movement of large amounts of money
senses.definitionCN: 以处理与调动大额资金为业的人
senses.example: The financier moved capital between three countries in a week.
senses.exampleCN: 这位金融家一周内在三个国家之间调动资本。
senses.why: The agent suffix marks a person who does the action of finance, so the first sense is simply one who deals in money at scale.
senses.whyCN: 表示施动者的后缀标示做「融资」这件事的人，因此第一义就是在很大规模上处理金钱的人。

senses.title: A banker or investment expert
senses.definition: a senior banker or investment professional who advises on and arranges capital
senses.definitionCN: 为资本安排与咨询的高级银行或投资专业人士
senses.example: The financier advised the board on how to raise the money.
senses.exampleCN: 这位金融家就如何筹资向董事会提供建议。
senses.why: Banking is the institutional home of large money dealing, so the word often means a senior banker or investment specialist.
senses.whyCN: 银行是大额金钱交易的主要机构，因此这个词常指高级银行家或投资专家。

senses.title: One who funds an enterprise
senses.definition: a person who provides the capital that lets a company or project operate
senses.definitionCN: 提供让公司或项目得以运转的资本的人
senses.example: A financier arranged the loan that kept the railway company alive.
senses.exampleCN: 一位金融家安排了让铁路公司得以存续的贷款。
senses.why: Capital has to come from somewhere, and the person who supplies it is named by this word in its funding sense.
senses.whyCN: 资本必须有来源，提供资本的人就由这个词的出资义来命名。

senses.title: A backer of a specific project
senses.definition: a supporter who puts money into a particular venture, expedition or institution
senses.definitionCN: 为特定事业、探险或机构投入金钱的支持者
senses.example: The expedition found a financier willing to pay for the ships.
senses.exampleCN: 探险队找到了一位愿意为船只出资的资助者。
senses.why: The word scales down from general finance to one venture when a single backer makes the project possible.
senses.whyCN: 当单个支持者让项目成为可能时，这个词就从一般金融缩小到一项事业。

senses.title: A financial adviser
senses.definition: an expert who gives advice on money, credit and the structure of a deal
senses.definitionCN: 就金钱、信贷与交易结构提供建议的专家
senses.example: The government hired a financier to restructure its debt.
senses.exampleCN: 政府聘请一位财政专家重组债务。
senses.why: Advice about money is a service in its own right, so the person-word also covers the advisory role.
senses.whyCN: 关于钱的建议本身是一种服务，因此这个指人的词也涵盖顾问角色。

senses.title: A state financier in historical use
senses.titleCN: 历史用法中的国家财政管理者
senses.definition: a historical official who managed public revenue for a ruler or state
senses.definitionCN: 历史上为君主或国家管理公共岁入的官员
senses.example: The old treasury was run by a financier answerable only to the king.
senses.exampleCN: 旧时的国库由一位只对国王负责的财政官管理。
senses.why: Before modern corporations, the biggest money manager was the state, so the word once named a public treasury official.
senses.whyCN: 在现代公司出现之前，最大的资金管理者是国家，因此这个词曾指公共财政官员。

senses.title: A speculator, often pejorative
senses.definition: a money dealer pictured as profiting from deals that do not create real goods, used as a criticism
senses.definitionCN: 被描绘成从不创造实物的交易中获利的金钱经营者，带批评意味
senses.example: Critics called the buyers financiers who never built anything.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者把这些买家称作从不建设任何东西的金融投机者。
senses.why: When money dealing is seen as detached from production, the word acquires a mocking tone.
senses.whyCN: 当金钱交易被视为脱离生产时，这个词就带上嘲讽口吻。

senses.title: To act as a financier
senses.definition: to arrange or provide the money for an enterprise, a rare verbal use
senses.definitionCN: 为企业安排或提供资金，属罕用的动词用法
senses.example: A small group financed the whole venture.
senses.exampleCN: 一个小团体为整个事业提供了资金。
senses.why: Nouns for roles often turn into verbs meaning 'to perform that role', and this word followed the same path.
senses.whyCN: 表示角色的名词常转为「履行该角色」的动词，这个词也走了同一条路。

intro.en: Financier comes through French from the noun finance, with an agent suffix meaning a person who acts. The root is Latin finis 'end'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 该词经法语来自名词「财政」，加上表示施动者的后缀，即「做这件事的人」。词根为拉丁 finis「终点」。年代均为约数。

items.en: Finis meant 'end, boundary, limit'; settling a debt was seen as bringing it to an end.
items.cn: finis 意为「终点、边界、界限」；了结债务被看作把它带到终点。

items.en: French finance named the settling of payments and the management of revenue, and it passed into English in the eighteenth century.
items.cn: 法语 finance 指款项的了结与岁入管理，于十八世纪进入英语。

items.en: A French agent suffix, from Latin -arius, was added to finance to name the person who handles it.
items.cn: 一个经法语来自拉丁的后缀被加到「财政」上，用来命名处理它的人。

items.en: The word spread with railway building and government borrowing, when large projects needed private backers.
items.cn: 随着铁路建设与政府借债，这个词流行起来，因为大型项目需要私人出资者。

items.en: In political writing the word could suggest a dealer profiting without producing anything, and that critical shade survives.
items.cn: 在政治写作中，这个词可暗示不事生产却获利的经营者，这一批评色彩保留至今。

items.en: Attestation uncertain (first citation): the earliest recorded use in English is not precisely dated, and French usage predates it.
items.cn: 首见年代不确定：英语中确切的最早用例没有年代，法语用法更早。

note.en: Group one separates the person-word from the activity and the adjective; group two holds other words for people who supply money.
note.cn: 第一组把指人的词与活动、形容词分开；第二组是其他表示出钱者的词。

entries.definition: Finance is the field or the act of funding; financier is the person who does it.
entries.definitionCN: finance 是领域或出资行为；financier 是做这件事的人。

entries.definition: Financing is the activity of raising funds; it cannot name a person.
entries.definitionCN: financing 是筹资活动，不能用来指人。

entries.definition: Financial describes money matters and never stands for a person.
entries.definitionCN: financial 描述金钱事务，从不指人。

entries.definition: A banker works within a banking institution, while a financier may operate across institutions and markets.
entries.definitionCN: banker 在银行机构内工作，financier 则可能跨机构与市场运作。

entries.definition: An investor puts money into assets expecting a return, a narrower role than arranging finance.
entries.definitionCN: investor 把钱投入资产以期待回报，比安排融资的角色更窄。

entries.definition: A backer funds a particular venture, often informally, while a financier usually works at a larger scale.
entries.definitionCN: backer 为特定事业出资，常较非正式；financier 通常规模更大。

entries.tag: industrial wealth not finance as s
entries.definition: A magnate is a powerful figure in an industry, whose wealth may be industrial rather than financial.
entries.definitionCN: magnate 是某一产业中的权势人物，其财富可能来自工业而非金融。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real agent suffix, the real family and the real historical shift.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的施动后缀、真实的词族与真实的历史变化。

normal.en: The suffix marks the doer: finance plus agent ending equals the person who handles money.
normal.cn: 后缀标示施动者：财政加施动词尾，就是处理金钱的人。

normal.en: It is a person word, unlike the field noun and the activity noun beside it.
normal.cn: 它是指人的词，与旁边的领域名词、活动名词不同。

normal.en: Railways and government debt made the role prominent in the nineteenth century.
normal.cn: 铁路与政府债务让这一角色在十九世纪显要起来。

normal.en: It can sound critical when money dealing seems detached from production.
normal.cn: 当金钱交易看似脱离生产时，它可能带批评意味。

normal.en: It also works as a rare verb, so the same spelling can be a noun or an action.
normal.cn: 它也可作罕用动词，因此同一拼写既可是名词也可是动作。

abstract.en: Picture a person at the end of a long table with other people's plans spread out.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人坐在长桌一端，桌上摊着别人的计划。

abstract.en: Picture a hand moving a line of credit from one city to another overnight.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手一夜之间把一笔信贷从一个城市移到另一个城市。

abstract.en: Picture a railway map drawn on top of a loan contract.
abstract.cn: 想象一张铁路地图画在贷款合同上面。

examples.en: A financier bought the failing line and rebuilt it within a year.
examples.cn: 一位金融家买下这条亏损的线路，一年内重建完成。

examples.en: The financier was criticized for earning fees without taking any risk.
examples.cn: 这位金融家因只收费用却不承担风险而受到批评。

examples.en: She worked as a financier for museums, raising funds for new wings.
examples.cn: 她为博物馆担任筹资人，为新展馆筹款。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「费」加「难说」再加「人」——专门替大项目把钱凑齐的人，就是金融家

root: 经法语来自名词「财政、金融」，原指债务的了结与岁入管理；加上表示施动者的后缀，指处理大额资金的人。词根为拉丁 finis「终点、界限」，与「结束、了结」相关。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one person: a dealer in large sums becomes a senior banker, then a funder of enterprises, a backer of one venture, an adviser, a state official, a criticized speculator and finally a rare verb.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个人展开：大额资金经营者先成为高级银行家，再成为企业出资者、单项事业资助者、顾问、国家财政官、受批评的投机者，最后转为罕用动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a figure at the end of a long table, other people's plans spread out before him.
core.cn: 核心意象：长桌一端的人，面前摊着别人的计划。

branches.en: THE PROFESSIONAL: large money dealing and the senior banking role.
branches.cn: 专业人士：大额资金交易与高级银行角色。

branches.en: THE FUNDER: capital for a company, and money for one expedition.
branches.cn: 出资者：为一家公司提供资本，也为一次探险出钱。

branches.en: THE ADVISER: money knowledge sold as counsel.
branches.cn: 顾问：把金钱知识作为建议出售。

branches.en: THE STATE: before corporations, the treasury was the biggest money office.
branches.cn: 国家：在公司出现之前，国库是最大的资金机构。

branches.en: THE CRITICISM AND THE VERB: detached dealing is mocked, and the role becomes an action.
branches.cn: 批评与动词：脱离实业的交易受嘲讽，角色也转为动作。

intro.en: The person-word is built from the noun of money management plus an agent suffix, and the whole family shares one Latin root.
intro.cn: 这个指人的词由「资金管理」名词加施动后缀构成，整个词族共享一个拉丁词根。

latinIntro.en: Finis and finire supply the root; the French agent ending supplies the person.
latinIntro.cn: finis 与 finire 提供词根，法语施动词尾提供「人」的含义。

items.meaning: a penalty that ends a case

definition_zh: 牧场；大农场；经营牧场；牧场住宅
definition_en: a large farm where cattle or other animals are raised
core_image: 一大片围起来的草地，几头牛在远处慢慢移动
scene: 山谷里的草地上散着牛群，围栏一直拉到看不见的坡顶。 Cattle moved slowly across the grass while the fence of the ranch ran up the hill out of sight.
sceneCN: 这里 ranch 指牧场（第 1 个义项：养牛的农场）；句意为山谷里的草地上散着牛群，围栏一直拉到看不见的坡顶。

senses.title: A cattle ranch
senses.definition: a large holding where cattle are raised on open land
senses.definitionCN: 在开阔土地上养牛的大农场
senses.example: Cattle moved slowly across the grass while the fence of the ranch ran up the hill out of sight.
senses.exampleCN: 牛群在草地上慢慢移动，牧场的围栏一直拉到看不见的坡顶。
senses.why: The first sense is land and animals together.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是土地与牲畜的结合。

senses.title: To run a ranch
senses.definition: to own and manage such a holding
senses.definitionCN: 拥有并管理这样一片农场
senses.example: His family had ranched the valley for three generations.
senses.exampleCN: 他家在这个山谷经营牧场已经三代。
senses.why: The verb turns the place into a livelihood.
senses.whyCN: 动词把地点变成生计。

senses.title: A ranch house
senses.definition: the main dwelling on such a farm, often low and wide
senses.definitionCN: 这类农场上的主要住所，通常低矮宽阔
senses.example: The ranch house had one long porch facing the hills.
senses.exampleCN: 牧场住宅有一个长长的门廊，正对着群山。
senses.why: The word attaches to buildings as well as land.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也附着在建筑上，而不只是土地。

senses.title: A ranch hand
senses.definition: a worker hired to care for animals and fences
senses.definitionCN: 受雇照看牲畜与围栏的工人
senses.example: A ranch hand checked the water trough before dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 一名牧场工人在天亮前检查了水槽。
senses.why: The compound names the people the land needs.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词命名土地所需要的人。

senses.title: A dude ranch
senses.definition: a working farm that takes paying guests
senses.definitionCN: 接待付费客人的牧场
senses.example: The dude ranch taught city visitors to ride.
senses.exampleCN: 这家度假牧场教城里来的客人骑马。
senses.why: The word can be sold as an experience.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可以被当作一种体验出售。

senses.title: A sheep ranch
senses.definition: the same holding turned to sheep or other stock
senses.definitionCN: 改为养羊或其他牲畜的同类农场
senses.example: The sheep ranch needed fewer hands than the old cattle one.
senses.exampleCN: 这家养羊场需要的人手比原来的养牛场少。
senses.why: The word adapts to whatever is raised.
senses.whyCN: 这个词随所养的东西而变。

senses.title: A distant ranch
senses.definition: a place measured by distance and isolation
senses.definitionCN: 以距离与孤立来衡量的地方
senses.example: The nearest ranch was a day's ride across the plain.
senses.exampleCN: 最近的牧场要横穿平原骑一天马。
senses.why: The sense is about separation, not agriculture.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项关乎隔绝，而非农业。

senses.title: Versus farm
senses.definition: open grazing land, as opposed to cultivated fields
senses.definitionCN: 开阔的放牧地，与耕作田地相对
senses.example: A farm grows crops; a ranch raises stock.
senses.exampleCN: farm 种庄稼，ranch 养牲畜。
senses.why: The pair separates two ways of working the same ground.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把同一片土地上的两种经营方式分开。

intro.en: Ranch comes from Spanish rancho, 'a group of people eating together', which named a hut and then a grazing farm.
intro.cn: ranch 来自西班牙语 rancho（一起吃饭的一群人），先指简陋住处，后指放牧农场。

items.en: Rancho first named a mess or a shared meal.
items.cn: rancho 最初指集体用餐或餐桌。

items.en: It then named a rough dwelling for workers.
items.cn: 随后指工人的简陋住处。

items.en: Mexican usage applied it to grazing estates.
items.cn: 墨西哥用法把它用在放牧庄园上。

items.en: English settlers carried the word north.
items.cn: 英国移民把这个词带向北方。

items.en: Today it covers cattle, sheep and guest farms.
items.cn: 今天它覆盖养牛、养羊与接待客人的农场。

note.en: The look-alike group is the ranch- family; the near-meaning group separates farm, estate, station and homestead.
note.cn: 形近组是 ranch 词族；近义组把「农场」「庄园」「牧站」「宅地」分开。

entries.definition: one who owns a ranch.
entries.definitionCN: 拥有牧场的人。

entries.definition: the business of a ranch.
entries.definitionCN: 牧场经营。

entries.definition: coarse or sexually explicit.
entries.definitionCN: 粗俗或露骨的。

entries.definition: a limb of a tree.
entries.definitionCN: 树枝。

entries.definition: land used to grow crops or keep stock.
entries.definitionCN: 种庄稼或养牲畜的土地。

entries.definition: a large area of owned land.
entries.definitionCN: 一大片自有土地。

entries.definition: a sheep or cattle property in Australia.
entries.definitionCN: 澳大利亚的牛羊牧场。

entries.definition: a farmhouse and its land.
entries.definitionCN: 农舍及其土地。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of open grass, a long fence and slow cattle.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「开阔草地、长围栏、慢慢走的牛」的画面。

normal.en: Ranch sounds like branch but means land: one grows on trees, one grows cattle.
normal.cn: ranch 听起来像 branch，却指土地：一个长在树上，一个养着牛。

normal.en: Picture a fence climbing a hill until it disappears.
normal.cn: 想象一道围栏爬上山坡，直到看不见。

normal.en: Say RAANCH; the vowel is long and open like the plain.
normal.cn: 读 RAANCH，元音长而开阔，像平原一样。

normal.en: A ranch hand works, a rancher owns, a dude ranch sells the day.
normal.cn: 牧场工人干活，牧场主拥有，度假牧场出售一天的生活。

normal.en: Farm grows crops; ranch raises stock.
normal.cn: farm 种作物，ranch 养牲畜。

abstract.en: A ranch is a business measured in acres and patience.
abstract.cn: 牧场是一门以英亩与耐心计量的生意。

abstract.en: The word carries the West as an image, even when the land is ordinary.
abstract.cn: 这个词带着西部的意象，哪怕土地很普通。

abstract.en: Distance is part of the meaning: a ranch is somewhere you must ride to.
abstract.cn: 距离是词义的一部分：牧场是你必须骑马才能到的地方。

examples.en: His family had ranched the valley for three generations.
examples.cn: 他家在这个山谷经营牧场已经三代。

examples.en: A ranch hand checked the water trough before dawn.
examples.cn: 一名牧场工人在天亮前检查了水槽。

examples.en: The nearest ranch was a day's ride across the plain.
examples.cn: 最近的牧场要横穿平原骑一天马。

dict_mnemonic.text: ranch 音近 branch，但牧场长的是牛，不是树枝。

root: 西班牙语 rancho（集体用餐处、简陋住处）

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses work the same land: cattle, the livelihood, the house, the hands, the guests, the sheep, the distance and the contrast with a crop farm.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项经营同一片土地：牛群、生计、住宅、工人、客人、羊群、距离，以及与作物农场的对照。

core.en: OPEN GRASS BEHIND A FENCE
core.cn: 围栏后的开阔草地

branches.en: The livelihood and the people it hires.
branches.cn: 生计与它雇用的人。

branches.en: Cattle and sheep as the stock raised.
branches.cn: 作为饲养对象的牛与羊。

branches.en: The house that faces the hills.
branches.cn: 面朝群山的住宅。

branches.en: The farm sold as an experience.
branches.cn: 被当作体验出售的农场。
